title: A Methodological Framework and Questionnaire for Investigating Perceived Algorithmic Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Scenario-based survey asking participants to evaluate the fairness of ride-sharing platforms using personalized pricing that may discriminate against low-income areas, as well as ad algorithms targeting based on affordability and budget.

Scenario-based survey asking participants to assess the fairness and personal impact of augmented-reality beauty filters that automatically lighten skin tones and alter facial features to conform to specific ethnic beauty standards.
Scenario-based survey asking participants to evaluate the fairness and psychological harm of personalized YouTube advertisements that reinforce gender stereotypes.

Scenario-based survey asking participants to evaluate the fairness of AI systems (such as LLMs and educational recommenders) that prioritize Western individualism over local cultural, regional, or religious values.

Scenario-based survey asking participants to assess the fairness of educational content suggestion algorithms that provide different quality content based on language and potentially disadvantage non-English speakers.
